message: Hi! I want to try a jiu jitsu class for myself. How do I start?
Hey! That's awesome. I'm Emma from Gracie Farmington Valley. We'd love to have you try a class! We offer a free trial for new students, no experience needed. What's your name?
Hi Emma! I'm Tester Quilo-ia40f. I'm really excited to try a class!
Great to meet you, Tester! So you're looking to try Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu for yourself, right? Just to confirm - you're 18 or older and booking for yourself?
Yes, that's correct! I'm 29 and booking for myself.
Perfect! To get you set up for your free trial, I just need a few quick details. What's the best email address for you?
My best email address is tester.a.ia40f@gmail.com.
Got it! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Perfect! Last thing - what's your date of birth? This just helps us keep our records organized.
Awesome, thanks! You'll start with our Adult Fundamentals Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu class. Let me check some available times for your free trial. What days work best for you this week?
I'm available any day this week! Just let me know what times you have.

Great! Here are some open slots this week:

- Today (Monday) at 6:30 PM
- Tuesday at 7:30 PM
- Wednesday at 6:30 PM

Which one works best for you?
Today at 6:30 PM works perfectly for me! I'm looking forward to it!

Perfect! You're all set for today at 6:30 PM for your free trial. We're at 15 Cheryl Dr d in Canton. Just wear comfortable workout clothes and we'll provide everything else. Can't wait to see you on the mat tonight!
